Фактом отцепляются вагоны, которые сейча: As a fact, wagons currently in the train are detached; as a plan, wagons of the expected consist at the detach time. Wagons behind the detached ones move forward. Detaching on a trip places the wagons at the stop station. Detaching removes the wagons from attendants in the train's trips with status "Planned".
Фактом прицепляется вагон, который стоит: A wagon is coupled as a fact only if it stands at the coupling station (at the station, in its depot or storage yard; on the way — at the stop station itself); other wagons — only as a plan. Wagons are placed in a row from the selected position, wagons from that position shift back. Coupling during a trip brings the wagon into the trip.
